summary_en: NCD raised FY2027 year-end dividend forecast to 80 yen per share (60 yen ordinary plus 20 yen commemorative), bringing full-year dividend to 140 yen per share. The interim dividend remains unchanged at 60 yen per share with record date September 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (60th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
NCD announced revisions to its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 during a board meeting held on November 6, 2026. The interim dividend is confirmed at 60 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026 and an effective date of December 2, 2026, matching the previous forecast made on May 15, 2026.

For the year-end dividend, the company increased its forecast from 60 yen per share to 80 yen per share, comprised of 60 yen as an ordinary dividend and 20 yen as a commemorative dividend. This increase was announced to commemorate the company's 60th anniversary, which falls on March 16, 2027. The company stated the commemorative dividend was a token of gratitude to shareholders and related parties for their long-standing support.

As a result, the full-year dividend forecast for fiscal 2027 has been raised to 140 yen per share, compared to the previous forecast of 120 yen per share. The company noted that the 20 yen commemorative dividend falls outside its progressive dividend policy framework.
